patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; monday sales CRM is narrower/specialist.

HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; monday sales CRM is narrower/specialist. Choose HubSpot only if your buying job matches “AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Ma” rather than monday sales CRM's shape. Choose monday sales CRM only if your buying job matches “Work OS–style sales CRM from monday.com for visual pipelines, automations, and team collab” rather than HubSpot's shape. Workflow advantage: HubSpot leans contact-management, account-management; monday sales CRM leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Workflow coverage skew: HubSpot-leaning contact-management, account-management, complex-sales-processes vs monday sales CRM-leaning —.
